summary: PUBG Mobile entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: PUBG Mobile
entries.definitive_edition: Current official mobile client with region/account/season documented

emulation.emulator: Official or allowed Android emulator only if service rules permit
emulation.notes: Prefer real mobile hardware for primary capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official mobile client on real hardware with exact region/season state

primary.why: PUBG Mobile is a live-service mobile battle royale distinct from PUBG: Battlegrounds on PC/console. Archive state depends on region, account, season, anti-cheat, maps/modes, events, monetization, and device performance.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official iOS/Android client. Record region, publisher/client version, account, season/royale pass, map/mode, graphics/frame-rate settings, device, controller/emulator status, event state, and network/server conditions.

secondary.platform: Regional variants such as Game for Peace/BGMI
secondary.what_to_play: Use only when documenting that region.
secondary.why: Regional builds are not interchangeable archive states.

all_releases.fidelity: Current official mobile battle royale route.
all_releases.reason: primary: only practical route for this game.

all_releases.fidelity: Region-specific builds with separate service rules and content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Live-service seasons, events, and regional builds cannot be fully reconstructed later.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with PUBG: Battlegrounds or regional variants unless labeled.
